result: The endpoint's code was all present — `routes/admin.ts` defined the `/admin/posts` route behind the `auth` alias and `AdminPostController` built the JSON payload, but nothing ever called `registerAdminRoutes`, so the route was never mounted (hence the 404 for guests and signed-in users alike). I wired it up in `routes/web.ts:6` (import) and `routes/web.ts:22` (calling `registerAdminRoutes(router)` right after `registerAuthRoutes(router)`, on the same router that carries the `'auth'`/`'guest'` aliases so the middleware alias resolves and guests are redirected to `/login`). I re-ran `bunx guren codegen`, which picked up the new named route in `.guren/routes.gen.ts` and `.guren/api-client.gen.ts`, and added `tests/AdminPostController.test.ts` asserting a guest hitting `/admin/posts` is redirected to `/login` rather than 404'ing. `bun run typecheck` passes, `bun test` is 3 pass / 0 fail (the ValidationException stack trace in the output is pre-existing log noise from the posts.search 422 test), and `bunx guren check` now reports `routes/admin.ts's registrar is called from routes/web.ts` with 0 failures.
